proposals.minimalRepair: Before registering or applying mutations, import ephemeralPgAvailable from scripts/lib/rcap-ephemeral-pg.mjs and emit an explicit environment-blocked result when it is false. Do not interpret a verifier SKIPPED exit as a green mutation result.
acceptance: With PostgreSQL available, all 12 mutations make the verifier red and the clean verifier passes.
Without PostgreSQL, the harness reports ENVIRONMENT_BLOCKED before modifying the migration.
The migration, mutation journal, and mutation lock remain clean after both cases.
proposals.reasonNotApplied: CB08 is triage-only and broad fixes are prohibited.
